title: What happens when I click Pay?

pieces.label: Click Pay
pieces.text: You press the Pay button on the checkout page.

pieces.label: Pay request
pieces.text: The page sends your cart and card to the server.

pieces.label: Cart not empty
pieces.text: The server stops here if your cart has nothing in it.

pieces.label: Card looks real
pieces.text: A quick math check on the card number, which charges nothing.

pieces.label: Save order
pieces.text: The order is written to the database, and a test checks this part.

pieces.label: Thank-you note
pieces.text: An AI writes a short thank-you note, a little different every time.

pieces.label: Order page
pieces.text: You see your order number and the note.

unsure.text: I didn't see whether the note is also sent by email.
